firm_data.firm_description: Herman Law Firm is a boutique law firm representing health insurers, self-funded plans, and plan administrators. They focus on reimbursement disputes and advise clients on regulatory matters pertaining to Medicaid, Marketplace, and Medicare.
notable_facts: Publishes Managed Care Litigation Update, a bi-weekly electronic publication.
Represents health insurers in high-profile cases navigating healthcare laws.
Offices in Texas, Louisiana, Mississippi, Massachusetts & California
technology_signals: Uses cutting-edge technology in the firm and in the courtroom (according to website).

email.subject: AI for Herman Law Firm, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Jonathan,

Your Managed Care Litigation Update reaches healthcare counsel nationwide, and I imagine managing reimbursement disputes at scale requires your team to work with precision that rivals larger firms. That's exactly where we're seeing the biggest gaps.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms facing BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in the Southwest to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by Dallas on Thursday, April 10 to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
